title: Derive a concrete microscopic SM–chi1 interaction and replace conditional gamma_el with a physically derived rate
objective: Build an explicit, internally consistent Lagrangian/EFT candidate (chi1, chi2, phi and SM portal) and derive momentum/temperature-dependent matrix elements and elastic, inverse and competing channels. Quantify H/decay/elastic hierarchy and limitations of the present BGK model.
prerequisites: Confirm current draft PR #1 branch HEAD and CI
steps: Audit quantum numbers, stability of phi, particle spins/degrees of freedom and decay threshold; distinguish toy assumptions from physical claims
Choose one minimal explicit SM portal; write interaction terms, allowed processes and parametric validity/domain

Derive vacuum decay width, thermal detailed-balance/chemical-potential relations, elastic momentum transfer rate gamma_el(p,T) and SM Q exchange with dimension checks; independently check at least one analytic limit
Estimate in physical regimes Gamma_decay/H, gamma_el/H, gamma_el/Gamma_decay and importance of 2->2 stimulated/number-changing channels
Implement reproducible dimensionful rates with unit/threshold/decoupling/detailed-balance tests and parameter scan; compare conservative BGK approximation to derived moments where valid
Document failures and distinguish inconclusive portal choice from falsified general hypothesis
Commit new code/tests/docs+checkpoint and push to research branch; immediately select and begin next most valuable step
deliverables: source code and independent physics tests
acceptance: Every claimed physical gamma_el or Gamma(T) is derived from explicit interaction(s) and stated kinematics, not guessed
Dimension analysis, detailed balance and physical thresholds tested
Independent check and exact reproducible command, dependency/version, parameter values, test results and limitations
Counterexamples and negative results retained, not tuned away
fallback: If portal selection blocked: separately derive model-independent consistency/inequality bounds on gamma_el/H vs Gamma/H and thermal masses, explicitly conditional
If numerical run unavailable: implement deterministic analytic/unit benchmark and preflight next BEST comparison; record tool blocker
If a physical hypothesis fails: record it and move to next defensible microscopic candidate, not a convenient replacement without disclosure
external_action_policy: GitHub only on existing research branch; no destructive force push, no main merge; Computer Use needs explicit user consent.
resume_instructions: Re-read AGENTS.md and these checkpoint files; reconcile PR #1 head SHA and latest CI; start by writing microphysics candidate and falsifiable acceptance, then code/tests. The next stage follows immediately after checkpoint/commit/push within available active runtime.
